title: metadata-protocol: a package-less row beside a disabled holder and served holders is served by save order on the plain read and /published, while /layers refuses naming the disabled package
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5obaLbqgzRUR9xXfft

Filing gate: ① a reproducible defect with a named location, measured on a booted kernel. It is the out-of-scope finding contract review record 6915442261 on PR #34355 names ("disabled holder + served holders"); PR #34355 does not move it, by scope.

## Location

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts`, `servedRowHolderOf`: past the no-disabled arm, `if (rows.unbound) return undefined;` leaves the read as it was whenever a package-less row is stored and any holder is disabled. `/published` reads the package-less row through its own path, and `/layers` refuses through `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal`, whose candidates are not judged over the served set.

## Symptom

With two enabled packages and one disabled package each storing a row of one name, plus a package-less row of it, `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/NAME` serves an enabled package's row or the package-less row depending on save order, `/published` serves the package-less row, and `/layers` refuses `409` naming the disabled package too.

## How found

Measured, not read. A probe on PR #34355's branch (tree `e0babb98e`, whose disabled arm is `main`'s) drove `HttpDispatcher.dispatch` and `getMetaItemForExecution` on a booted kernel (the real protocol, metadata service, registry and `sys_metadata` store; the `[#32354]` harness in `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`). Packages E and F enabled, D disabled (`registry.disablePackage`), registered D, E, F; dashboard `dis_dash`:

| Rows saved (in order) | plain read | `/published` | `/layers` | execution read |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| E, F, D, package-less | 200 E's row | 200 package-less row | 409 naming E, D, F | E's row |
| package-less, D, F, E | 200 package-less row | 200 package-less row | 409 naming E, D, F | package-less row |
| E, D, package-less | 200 E's row | 200 package-less row | 409 naming E, D | E's row |
| CONTROL: E, F, D (no package-less row) | 409 naming E, F | 409 naming E, F | 409 naming E, F | `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` |

The CONTROL is the answer #32354 settled: a disabled package holds no name and is never named. The package-less row breaks it in three ways: the plain read follows save order, `/published` serves the package-less row in place of the holders, and `/layers` names the disabled package.

reach: public HTTP door, measured: `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/NAME` answers `200` with the package-less row when it was saved first and `200` with E's row when E's was, and `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/NAME/layers` answers `409` with the disabled package in `details.candidates`.

## Acceptance

1. Two enabled holders' rows, a disabled holder's row and a package-less row of a name no package ships: the plain read, `/published`, `/layers` and the execution read naming no package all refuse `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming exactly the two enabled holders, never the disabled one, and never serve the package-less row, in every save order of the four rows.
2. One enabled holder's row, a disabled holder's row and a package-less row: every bare door gives one answer, the enabled holder's row, as the no-disabled CONTROL of #33210 (one holder beside a package-less row) does, and no door names the disabled package.
3. CONTROL: the same rows with no package-less row keep the answer in the table above (`409` naming the two enabled holders on every bare door).
4. CONTROL: each exact address (`?package=E`, `?package=F`) serves its own row; `?package=D` answers the withheld `404` while D is disabled.
5. Both registration orders (the disabled package first, and last), before and after a reboot (re-disabling after the boot, as the harness does).
6. Pins in the shared harness `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts` (one top-level `describe`), and on `RestServer` in `packages/rest/src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts`; an ablation of each arm the fix adds, its run quoted in the PR.

## Declaration it would need

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` (the plain read and `/published` move from served to refused; nothing moves from refused to served), `Metadata-protocol: none`, `!` in the title, a BREAKING banner, and an ADR-0087 disposition: check whether `two-row-holders-bare-read-refused` already covers the shape (two or more enabled packages hold the name only as stored rows) or a new semantic entry is needed.

## Related

- #33210 / PR #34355: the same shape with no disabled holder (refused there).
- #32354, #32183: a disabled package holds no name and is never named.
- #32607: two enabled row holders refused on every bare door.
- #34348: the save side of a package-unbound row beside disabled-only or two enabled holders (decision card; read side not covered).

Dedupe: searched `is:issue "package-less row" "disabled holder" repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack` (34 hits), `is:issue package-less disabled holder layers refuses repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack` (57 hits) and `is:issue is:open "package-less" "disabled" "plain read" repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack` (9 hits) on 2026-11-16; none reports this read-side shape (closest: #33210, no disabled holder; #34348, the save side).
